name: 素色垂顺简约床品套件款
description: 素色垂顺面料、整洁铺床效果与真实卧房安睡场景

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternate a soft sunlit bedroom with a light tufted headboard and small bedside props against clean infographic fields on off-white, plus a cool sky-and-cloud dream field; every bedroom wall and every panel keeps one fixed warm oatmeal or off-white tone
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight as the master system, front key with a low fill card, a gentle skimming side light that reveals weave, drape and hem stitching, sweeping highlight along folded edges, low-contrast contact shadows, fabric always resting on the mattress and never floating
styleLock.surfaceSystem: made bed on a light platform base with warm matte floor; infographic panels on a smooth off-white board; fabric laid, folded or knotted flat, never suspended without support
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; any in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and supplied only as generic placeholders, headline 28-40pt, label 10-14pt, no serif or handwriting mixing, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icon chips and rounded label chips in the misted slate-blue accent, single stroke weight, empty ruled label lines instead of values
styleLock.presentationRules: stable eye-level slight 3/4 hero angle for the dressed bed, identical scale and spacing across variant rows, consistent fabric drape direction, product always grounded with a contact shadow
noDrift: no invented dimensions, piece counts, certifications or test data
no brand wordmark, barcode, QR code or member badge
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cosy premium home-textile bedding visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean off-white background #FFFFFF, warm oatmeal field #F1EAE1, misted slate-blue accent #7C8496 and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; warm temperature; one modern geometric sans-serif family with any in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and supplied only as generic placeholders; backgrounds alternate between a soft sunlit bedroom with a light tufted headboard and small bedside props and clean infographic panels on an off-white field, plus one cool sky-and-cloud dream field; soft diffused daylight as the master lighting system with a front key, a low fill card and a gentle skimming side light that reveals weave, drape and hem stitching, sweeping highlights along folded edges and low-contrast contact shadows, fabric always resting on a surface and never floating; consistent thin-line circular icon chips and rounded label chips in the misted slate-blue accent with empty ruled label lines instead of values; stable eye-level slight 3/4 hero angle and stable product scale across all screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers or certifications, no brand marks, barcodes or QR codes.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 铺床成品图（软包床头+台灯，画面底部另有一条多色打结布样陈列带）；002 两人一幼童与一犬同卧的晨间画面；003 成品床加三个圆角浮标与虚线引线标注套件构成，含尺寸与件数数值及一行不含床垫床架枕芯的脚注；004 二乘二工艺宫格（枕套开口、松紧收边、包住床角、床单折边）并带四条英文标签与两处不含说明；005 云朵天空环绕床铺的安睡画面并带两行英文标题；006 两成人撑起床单、幼童跳床的嬉闹画面，带大标题与右下角认证徽标；007 人物把布件送入滚筒洗衣机的护理画面，带大标题与四个线性图标标签，机身为他牌家电并带屏显；008 吊牌小票式清单卡，顶部为源品牌字标、中部为成品床与叠放件、下部两列文字清单、脚注与条码。品类判定依据：画面主体为铺在床上的床单床笠与枕套组合，全片为卧房与护理场景，故 L1 取家具家纺、L2 取床品，leaf 定为素色垂顺床品套件；源提示的类目线索仅作检索参考。已剥离内容：源字标与店铺字样、右下角认证徽标、吊牌卡上的品牌标识行与全部条码数字、机身上的牌铭与屏显读数（改为完全空白无读数）、八张图内全部英文标题与标签原句（改为「」占位或空白参数行/空表格单元/空图标标签位）、套件件数与全部尺寸规格类数值主张、全部人物与幼童的面容身份（仅保留背影或颈部以下裁切）、床品具体颜色（改由 {product} 与 {accent_color} 注入）。首镜为铺床主图、末镜为清单收口信任镜，痛点镜由工艺镜中的包角与松紧结构反推得到。
